newsitem.title: FRANCE: HORSE RACING-HELISSIO WORKS WELL AHEAD OF MAJOR ASCOT CLASH.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-HELISSIO WORKS WELL AHEAD OF MAJOR ASCOT CLASH.

text.p: Helissio, the French superstar favourite to win the King George VI and Queen Elizabeth Diamond Stakes at Ascot on Saturday, worked well at Chantilly on Monday.
The runaway Arc de Triomphe winner was put through his paces over nine furlongs (1.8 km) at ''Les Aigles'' where he worked with two other horses.
Partnered by Cash Asmussen, Helissio drew clear in the last 300 metres without ever being asked a serious question by his Texan-born rider.

Bruno Ridoux, racing manager to owner Enrique Sarasola, said: ''It was nice piece of work and a good piece of fine tuning considering that he did a hard piece of work last week. We are pleased with the horse's condition."
Saturday's event promises to be one of the biggest races for years.
Principal opposition to Helissio is expected to come from the Michael Stoute-trained pair, Singspiel and Pilsudski.
Singspiel is coming off hat-trick of big wins in the Japan Cup, Dubai World Cup and Coronation Cup.
Pilsudski, slammed five lengths by Helissio in the Arc de Triomphe, has since covered himself in glory in the Breeders' Cup Turf and Eclipse Stakes at Sandown.
Latest betting: 13-8 Helissio, 2-1 Singspiel, 7-2 Pilsudski, 10-1 Kingfisher Mill, 12-1 Shantou, 14-1 Swain, Predappio, 25-1 Strategic Choice.
